title: Fleet Late Balance Fee: Open-Account Credit Use Add-On Table
content:
Vehicle Purchase Agreements, Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement. A fleet buyer drawing on the open credit of their service account pays a credit-use add-on to the monthly rate of the fleet late balance fee. The figures read are the open balance and the credit limit of the buyer's active account with Service Accounts and Repair Orders.

**Clause.**
- Where the active service account's open balance is **more than 60 percent (0.6)** of its credit limit, the add-on is **0.25 percent (0.0025)**.
- Where the open balance is **at least 40 percent (0.4) but not more than 60 percent** of the credit limit, the add-on is **0.1 percent (0.001)**.
- Below 40 percent, or where the account carries no credit limit, there is no add-on.

### Decision table

| Open balance as a part of the credit limit | Credit-use add-on |
|---|---|
| more than 60 percent | 0.25 percent per month |
| exactly 60 percent | 0.1 percent per month |
| at least 40 percent and not more than 60 percent | 0.1 percent per month |
| exactly 40 percent | 0.1 percent per month |
| below 40 percent | none |
| no credit limit on the account (0.00 or none) | none |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical account, credit limit 18,000.00)
- Open balance 10,800.01, just above 60 percent: add-on 0.25 percent.
- Open balance 10,800.00, exactly 60 percent and so not more than 60 percent: add-on 0.1 percent.
- Open balance 7,200.00, exactly 40 percent and so at least 40 percent: add-on 0.1 percent.
- Open balance 7,199.99, below 40 percent: no add-on.

### Points of judgement
- The comparison uses the open balance and the credit limit of the buyer's service account that is in active status, as Service Accounts and Repair Orders records them on the handling date.
- An account with no credit limit gives no add-on, whatever its open balance.
